title: innerText issues

labels.name: compat
labels.description: Standard is not web compatible or proprietary feature needs standardizing

body:
When working on https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/1678 I found the following issues. cc @rocallahan ## Getter - [x] What should non-CSS UAs do? (https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/1678/commits/45253f93a4c443113eeb8cbfd32263de259dca76) - [x] Is "content order" for CSS boxes defined? (Step 2.5.) (Issue moved to https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/421 ) - [x] The `rp` check only works for direct children of `rp`, not descendants (e.g. `(...`). Do we want that to work? Or change the content model or `rp` to "text"? (https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/1690) - [ ] Issue inline in the spec: > This algorithm is amenable to being generalized to work on a ranges. Then we can use it as the basis for Selection's stringifier and maybe expose it directly on ranges. See [Bugzilla bug 10583](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=10583). - [x] @annevk [said](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/1678#issuecomment-240419192): > The only thing I'd consider changing further is making the recursion less declarative. Have that be some algorithm that is invoked for each child and also put the result in a variable of some kind the rest of the algorithm uses. @zcorpan [said](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/1678#issuecomment-240427926): > Yeah, it could use some more cleanup. Possibly also switch to iterative traversal instead of recursive? https://github.com/whatwg/html/commit/2202c6c4646b74ad67513916dc2a282cdc879001 ## Setter - [x] The setter needs to be better defined, in terms of DOM concepts so mutation observers are invoked correctly etc. (https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/1678/commits/0783a6169c439d84bc0ea5d68f9eaa2240fca044) - [x] `innerText = null;` WebKit/Chromium "", Gecko/IE "null". (https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/1678/commits/618de8424d04a57515b603730cbfef1df77a8d9a , https://github.com/w3c/web-platform-tests/pull/3482) - [x] Chromium throws for `
.innerText = "x"` etc, Gecko does not. https://cs.chromium.org/chromium/src/third_party/WebKit/Source/core/html/HTMLElement.cpp?sq=package:chromium&dr=CSs&rcl=1471276009&l=140 https://cs.chromium.org/chromium/src/third_party/WebKit/Source/core/html/HTMLElement.cpp?sq=package:chromium&dr=CSs&rcl=1471276009&l=454 (https://github.com/w3c/web-platform-tests/pull/3491) - [x] Only update existing text node's data if element has just 1 text node? https://cs.chromium.org/chromium/src/third_party/WebKit/Source/core/editing/serializers/Serialization.cpp?sq=package:chromium&dr=CSs&rcl=1471276009&l=640 (https://github.com/w3c/web-platform-tests/pull/3493) - [x] If the assigned value starts with a newline, WebKit/Chromium insert an empty text node, Gecko/IE don't. (Current spec matches Gecko/IE.) (https://github.com/w3c/web-platform-tests/pull/3492) (Filed [chromium bug 639064](https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=639064), [webkit bug 160971](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=160971), [edge bug 8536472](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/platform/issues/8536472/) for some of the above bullet points) ## Other known issues - [ ] https://github.com/rocallahan/innerText-spec/issues/2 - [ ] https://github.com/rocallahan/innerText-spec/issues/3 - [x] https://github.com/rocallahan/innerText-spec/issues/4 (https://github.com/w3c/web-platform-tests/pull/3589) - [x] https://github.com/rocallahan/innerText-spec/issues/5 (https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/1717)
